mode: manual paper research; no betting qualification
ordering: Scheduled start, then provider game ID; no edge-based ranking
marketProbability: Within-book proportional normalization of two same-event moneyline implied probabilities; no cross-book synthetic pairs
primaryForecast: First successfully saved forecast per game under this policy. Keep policy cohorts separate; earlier policy captures remain in the ledger.
evaluation: All primary forecasts with verified final scores; paired model vs mean available within-book no-vig probabilities on the same eligible subset; no ROI or selected-bet claims
retrieval: Fresh current-season game pages from season start through tomorrow, exhausted within bound. Fresh odds only for capture, never for result checking. Failed or empty captures are recorded.
features: Only prior-date final results with source observedAt <= cutoff; current-date scores excluded. Historical seeds must have been collected before cutoff; their availability is not backdated.
exclusions: Only scheduled regular-season games at least 15 minutes in the future on the capture's Eastern date; exclude Cup final, postponed, unknown status, ambiguous matches, already-started games, unsupported teams and insufficient or unresolved history.
settlement: Append-only score observations for captured 2026 games. Validate provider ID, team identity, scheduled start and final state; corrections append a successor record. No sportsbook settlement or returns.
uncertaintyIntervals: Research-only empirical 80% margin prediction interval; integer spread cover/push distribution
amends: Separate prospective candidate cohort; forward-001/002 and baseline-001 remain unchanged
comparison: Original baseline beside candidate on each fresh input cutoff; no recommendations
